description: Complete wiring for snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) into approval_workflow. snow_connector.py is present but not integrated per Appendix A gap listing. This directive wires the ServiceNow inbound webhook handler to call approval_workflow.create_submission() when a new MCP request ticket arrives. Must: (1) fetch pending submissions from mcp_submissions via registry_api, (2) submit each to trust_synthesiser_v2 for verdict check, (3) write decision back to mcp_decisions via write_service, (4) heartbeat every 60s to service_health. No direct DB access. Use write_service :8772 for all state. ServiceNow OAuth token refresh via snow_connector.py helper.
